backend/main.mo: Defines core types (users, matches, analyses, tickets), comparison helpers, and in-memory maps with migration and access-control mixin for the backend actor.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a simple migration stub that converts old actor state to new state without transformation.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata mapping features to related frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists human‑written summaries for many frontend source files, describing their purpose and UI behavior.
frontend/index.css: Empty placeholder stylesheet for global frontend styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the SPA root and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router route tree and wraps the application in a ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: Displays an access‑denied card with messaging and a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminBoots: UI for bootstrapping the first admin user with mutation handling and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoute: Route guard that allows admins through, shows bootstrap screen if no admins exist, or shows access denied.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with loading states and query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting new authenticated users to create a profile and saving it via mutation.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Authentication gate that prompts unauthenticated users to sign in before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main application layout with header, navigation, content outlet, profile setup dialog, and footer, including responsive mobile menu handling.
frontend/src/components/matches/Confiden: Renders a styled badge indicating prediction confidence level based on predefined visual configurations.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Prima: Implements primary navigation with desktop and mobile variants, highlighting active routes and conditionally showing admin links.
frontend/src/components/payments/Upgrade: Provides a dialog for selecting subscription tier and payment provider, handling confirmation and triggering subscription upgrade.
frontend/src/components/vip/OddsTrainPro: Displays progress of completed vs total Odds Train legs using a progress bar and summary stats.
frontend/src/components/vip/VipLockedCar: Shows a locked VIP content card prompting users to upgrade their subscription.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the current user's profile and role using the actor, exposing admin status and loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state and actions, loading stored identities and managing login workflow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating match, ticket, user, and admin data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and a custom dark gold Phoenix theme with utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/subscription.ts: Contains helper functions for subscription labels and determining VIP or premium access.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Implements the admin interface for managing matches, analyses, tickets, admin promotion, and results.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the home dashboard with today's matches, VIP links, and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/MatchAnalysisPage.tsx: Shows detailed match analysis with VIP access checks and related tickets for a selected match.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays authenticated user profile details including name, email, join date, and subscription status, with upgrade options for non‑VIP users.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx: Aggregates tickets and backend results to compute win/loss stats, streaks, and performance KPIs, displaying them in a results dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/TicketsPage.tsx: Shows all VIP tickets with details such as odds, type, selections, and status, offering links to view more predictions when none exist.
frontend/src/pages/VipPage.tsx: Renders VIP‑only prediction categories and tickets, gating access based on subscription and organizing content into tabs for safe, value, and train predictions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading and persisting URL parameters, supporting both querystring and hash routing along with session storage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, specifying content paths, and extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and components with custom OKLCH variables.
project_state.json: Project state file describing app specs, architecture, known issues, and existing features for the Phoenix Predictions FlutterFlow/Firebase build.
